# gitmoap_repository_branch_rule (Data Source)

Get a branch rule by ID. One of the repository's own branch rules: its pattern, the levels needed to push and merge, its force-push and code-owner settings, and its allowlists. Anyone who can see the repository may read it.

The token needs `branch_rule:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

resource "gitmoap_repository_branch_rule" "main" {
  repo_id        = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
  branch_pattern = "main"
}

data "gitmoap_repository_branch_rule" "api" {
  branch_rule_id = gitmoap_repository_branch_rule.main.branch_rule_id
  repo_id        = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch_rule_id` (String) Branch rule ID
- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID

### Read-Only

- `allow_force_push` (Boolean)
- `allowed_to_merge` (String)
- `allowed_to_push` (String)
- `branch_pattern` (String)
- `merge_allowlist` (List of String)
- `push_allowlist` (List of String)
- `repository_id` (String)
- `require_code_owner_approval` (Boolean)
